items.title: Sodilflow

items.title: Sodilog Intranet

agents.title: AI & Agents
agents.subtitle: Agent philosophy
agents.intro: In my Big Data Master's at Epitech, I design agent-based systems focused on controllability, observability, and real-world constraints rather than opaque autonomy.

principles.title: Why agents
principles.description: An agent goes beyond scripted automation by adapting to context. In complex business systems, this helps handle exceptions and uncertainty.

principles.title: How I design them
principles.description: I start from the business need. Simple loop: objective, context, actions, constraints, observability. Then APIs, rules and LLMs when relevant, with reliability first.

principles.title: Real-world applications
principles.description: ERP automation, data reconciliation and intelligent routing. Goal: useful systems that improve infrastructure without introducing instability.

aviation.title: Aviation
aviation.description: In aviation, precision and clarity are critical. The same discipline applies when designing reliable systems.

astronomy.title: Astronomy
astronomy.description: Astronomy provides perspective on scale and time. In information systems, historical state continuously shapes present decisions.

volleyball.title: Volleyball
volleyball.description: A team sport where timing, anticipation and coordination matter, principles that translate well to distributed systems.
